text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - rule 'gateway_5xx_rate' triggered for service 'inference-gateway' (eu-west1). 5xx rate jumped to 11.8% over 5m (baseline ~0.3%).

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification sent to rotation: infra-oncall (mike_oncall).

mike_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Thanks for the ping. Can someone paste the runbook link?

jamie_sre: Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/5xx-gateway|5xx gateway runbook> - there are playbooks for throttling, route rollback, and model fallback.

lee_infra: Observability: there's a spike across /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions, originating from eu-west1 frontends -> router g-kraken-*. Latency also increased. Might be a bad canary rollout or upstream model slowdowns.

mike_oncall: Good. Start with quick impact: which customers? ana_cs can you triage customer exposure?

ana_cs: (ana_cs) I'm pulling the affected token list now. Initial look: ~8 high-volume tokens seeing >20% error rates, 12 mid-volume with intermittent 5xx. Notified account owners where we have direct contacts. Recommend holding public comms until we know blast radius.

lee_infra: Quick checks I ran:
```
# recent error rate by router
kubectl logs router-g-kraken-0 --since=10m | grep "5.." | wc -l
# connections
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
```
Errors show upstream 502s from backend pool model-host-42 and increased TCP retries.

jamie_sre: Can we toggle fallback to older model-variant (v1.3) for the affected route? That usually reduces backend timeouts.

mike_oncall: Deploy-bot, can you run a controlled rollback on canary routing for eu-west1? If not, we'll switch to fallback.

deploy-bot: Command queued by mike_oncall: `redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west1 --route /v1/generate --variant stable-v1.3 --reason "automated mitigation for 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: Started rollout. Estimated completion ~30s.

jamie_sre: While that's rolling, I'll tail the backend logs for model-host-42.

jamie_sre: Observed : model process hitting OOMs and repeated GC stalls ~1m before spike. Possible memory regression in recent quantization build.

lee_infra: If it's an OOM regression, we should demote that host from LB pool. Running command: `redwoodctl infra drain model-host-42 --reason "OOM suspected"`

mike_oncall: Do it. Also scale up model-host pool to absorb traffic. `redwoodctl infra scale model-pool-eu-west --replicas +3`

deploy-bot: Drain started for model-host-42. Scale command accepted; provisioning 3 extra instances (gpu-rt-rtx).

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident classified as SEV2 (customer impact, partial degradation), bridge created: <https://zoom.redwood/bridge/1802504321>.

ana_cs: Customer update draft for owners: "We're investigating increased error rates for some inference requests in eu-west1. We're mitigating and will follow up with ETA once traffic stabilizes." (ok to copy?)

product-support: That's reasonable. Add "no data loss" and mention we may route to alternate variants to restore service.

mike_oncall: Rollout completed. Early signal: 5xx down to 3.5% and falling. Continue monitoring for 10m.

jamie_sre: After drain, model-host-42 shows OOM traces and a new quantize loader in logs. Confirmed regression in model binary: `quantize_v2.1` loaded ~2h ago.

lee_infra: I'll mark that build as suspect in CI and block future canaries until patch.

mike_oncall: Can we patch the canary gate to fail fast on OOM signatures? Also add KV cache health check to routing decisions.

jamie_sre: I'll open PR for an OOM health probe and a threshold change. Putting notes in incident tracker.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation success criteria met? Current 5xx rate = 1.2% over 5m, still slightly elevated but within SLO degradation window.

mike_oncall: I'm going to handoff to jamie_sre for the next shift. I'll update pager and assign follow-ups: (1) RCA for canary regression, (2) automation to demote hosts faster, (3) customer comms timeline.

jamie_sre: Acked handoff. I'll stay on the bridge for the next 3 hours, then pass to lee if needed.

ana_cs: I'll send targeted notes to affected accounts with expected follow-up within 2 hours. Template included in bridge notes.

product-support: Prep internal postmortem checklist. Customer-facing post will be drafted after RCA.

mike_oncall: Final status: incident moved to mitigation mode, SEV2 -> monitoring. If 5xx goes above 2% again, auto-escalate to SEV1. Closing initial paging thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by mike_oncall. Incident state: acknowledged -> mitigated.

deploy-bot: Note: model-host-42 remains drained, awaiting forensic logs copy to s3: `s3://redwood-incidents/1802504321/host-42-logs.tar.gz`.

jamie_sre: Adding timeline notes to incident tracker and will start RCA doc.

ana_cs: Customer notifications sent to owners for high-volume tokens. Monitoring dashboards show steady recovery.

lee_infra: Follow-up ops tasks: patch canary gate, add OOM alert, add traffic-shed playbook. Assigning to infra backlog.

mike_oncall: Handed off. Good job team.

incident-bot: :locked: Thread locked for edits by incident lead after SEV2 handoff.
